notes: The dashboard was renamed to 工作看板 and restructured as a multi-module container: the sidebar entry and plugin card read 工作看板, the page title is the module name (POC 运营), the shell identity sits in an eyebrow, and a module tab rail marks the only module today while leaving a visible seat for future ones. The whole 导入数据 module was deleted — its Host actions (validate/submit/template), the pr/validate/diff/template modules, the import and create pages, and the draft-PR write path are gone, so the plugin is now strictly read-only. The visual layer was rebuilt: a three-level surface ramp with one shadow ramp, gradient primary buttons, accent-backed stat cards, layered panels with tinted headers, a module tab strip, uppercase table headers, ring-highlighted current stage markers, and a full dark-theme palette. 50/50 assertions passed in both themes with no uncaught page errors. A real defect was found and fixed during verification: the client bundle used the classic JSX transform with no React binding in scope, so the sidebar entry crashed with 'React is not defined'; the build now emits the automatic react/jsx-runtime, pinned by a regression test.
